question: Which customers are probably Champions?

question: Which boundary customers have uncertain segment membership under GMM?
gold_sql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT customer_id, segment, p, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY p DESC, CASE segment WHEN 'Champions' THEN 1 WHEN 'Loyal' THEN 2 WHEN 'At-Risk' THEN 3 WHEN 'New' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id) AS k_segments FROM segment_membership WHERE snapshot = 'S3' AND method = 'gmm'), pc AS (SELECT customer_id, MAX(p) AS max_p, MAX(CASE WHEN rn=1 THEN segment END) AS top_segment, MAX(CASE WHEN rn=2 THEN segment END) AS second_segment, MAX(CASE WHEN rn=2 THEN p END) AS second_p, SUM(CASE WHEN p>0 THEN -p*LN(p)/LN(k_segments) ELSE 0 END) AS normalised_entropy FROM ranked GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT pc.customer_id, c.country, pc.top_segment, ROUND(pc.max_p,4) AS max_p, pc.second_segment, ROUND(pc.second_p,4) AS second_p, ROUND(pc.normalised_entropy,4) AS normalised_entropy, cf.recency_days, cf.frequency, ROUND(cf.monetary,2) AS monetary FROM pc JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = pc.customer_id JOIN customer_features cf ON cf.customer_id = pc.customer_id AND cf.snapshot = 'S3' WHERE pc.max_p < 0.60 LIMIT 500

question: What is the expected segment size for each segment?
gold_sql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT sm.customer_id, sm.segment, sm.p, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sm.customer_id ORDER BY sm.p DESC, CASE sm.segment WHEN 'Champions' THEN 1 WHEN 'Loyal' THEN 2 WHEN 'At-Risk' THEN 3 WHEN 'New' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END) AS rn FROM segment_membership sm JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = sm.customer_id WHERE sm.snapshot = 'S3' AND sm.method = 'bootstrap') SELECT r.segment, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.rn = 1) AS hard_count, ROUND(SUM(r.p), 2) AS expected_size, ROUND(SUM(r.p) - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.rn = 1), 2) AS expected_minus_hard, ROUND(SUM(r.p * (1.0 - r.p)), 2) AS variance_independent, ROUND(SQRT(SUM(r.p * (1.0 - r.p))), 2) AS std_dev_independent FROM ranked r GROUP BY r.segment

question: What is the expected revenue per segment?
gold_sql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT sm.customer_id, sm.segment, sm.p, cf.monetary, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sm.customer_id ORDER BY sm.p DESC, CASE sm.segment WHEN 'Champions' THEN 1 WHEN 'Loyal' THEN 2 WHEN 'At-Risk' THEN 3 WHEN 'New' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END) AS rn FROM segment_membership sm JOIN customer_features cf ON cf.customer_id = sm.customer_id AND cf.snapshot = sm.snapshot JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = sm.customer_id WHERE sm.snapshot = 'S3' AND sm.method = 'bootstrap') SELECT r.segment, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN r.rn = 1 THEN r.monetary ELSE 0.0 END), 2) AS hard_revenue, ROUND(SUM(r.p * r.monetary), 2) AS expected_revenue, ROUND(SUM(r.p * r.monetary) - SUM(CASE WHEN r.rn = 1 THEN r.monetary ELSE 0.0 END), 2) AS expected_minus_hard_revenue, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(r.p * r.monetary) / NULLIF(SUM(SUM(r.p * r.monetary)) OVER (), 0.0), 2) AS expected_revenue_share_pct FROM ranked r GROUP BY r.segment
